title: Cooling Tower Hybrid Fill - ICST
description: Cooling tower hybrid Fill for counterflow and crossflow cooling towers. Folds for easy shipping and can be arranged and spaced for optimal cooling performance.

bullets.text: Cooling tower hybrid fill folds into nested bundles for easy, cost-effective shipping, storage, and installation.
Simple, bottom-supported installation (No field assembly or hangers required).
TurboSplash PACs can be configured in various spacings and angles to optimize performance.
Constructed of durable, trouble-free Polyproylene Copolymer that is resistant to alkalis, acids, and oils.
Available in 4″ (SF100) and 6″ (SF150) pair spread configurations.
